name: homelabdash
description: A self-hosted dashboard for your homelab, configured in one YAML file. Edit /config/homelabdash.yaml and the page follows every save; the first start writes a starter file to begin from. Tiles update live, can graph their last hour, and raise alerts you can dismiss. 16 plugins come built in, among them Tautulli, the arrs, Seerr, qBittorrent, SABnzbd, Docker, Unraid, apcupsd, AdGuard Home and OpenWrt, and you can write your own. There is no login by default, so keep it on your LAN or put it behind a reverse proxy that signs you in.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: What you edit: homelabdash.yaml, secrets.yaml, and your own plugins, icons and custom.css.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: What the dashboard writes itself: dismissed alerts, plugin state, graph history and cached icons.
